id.description: Action Definition identifier. The Invocation ActionReference uses the canonical Action ID grammar defined by the Action Definition contract; it is not a separate identifier namespace.

version.description: Exact Action Definition version this invocation addresses.

bindingId.description: Optional reference to the RuntimeBinding executing this invocation. Lexically identical to RuntimeBinding.bindingId (minLength 1, maxLength 240); nullable because the binding layer may be introduced later.

clientMeta.description: Non-authoritative metadata. Must never provide identity, tenant, roles, permissions, binding authority, or confirmation authority.
